title: Docker Engine installs from the elicited apt channel: the observable repository source matches
asA: operator installing the container host on a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 12 baseline
iWant: the shipped installer script to resolve the elicited docker-engine-channel answer into the apt sources entry actually written to the host, and to refuse any other value with a named error kind
soThat: a project verifying against test can trust the installed engine is on the pre-release channel; a project on stable can trust it is on the stable channel

acceptanceCriteria.description: With docker-engine-channel=stable, the installer writes an apt sources entry pointing at the vendor stable pool; the observable file at /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list carries the "stable" pool component; dpkg -s docker-ce reports a version from the stable pool. With docker-engine-channel=test, the same file carries the "test" component and dpkg -s reports a version from the test pool.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 baseline with no prior docker-ce install
acceptanceCriteria.when: the installer script runs against the elicited channel
acceptanceCriteria.then: the apt sources file carries the elicited pool component and the installed docker-ce matches

acceptanceCriteria.description: The installer refuses any elicited docker-engine-channel value outside {stable, test} with a stable error kind DOCKER_ENGINE_CHANNEL_UNSUPPORTED naming the offered value and lists the accepted options in the message. No apt sources entry is written on refusal.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a docker-engine-channel elicit answer set to "nightly" (or any other unrecognised value)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the installer refuses with DOCKER_ENGINE_CHANNEL_UNSUPPORTED and no apt sources entry lands
